title: Assimp DXF geometry-projection boundary
mode: Primary-source cross-project research and implementation-plan refinement
scope: Broaden the DWG/DXF open-source comparison to include a 3D scene importer, distinguishing mesh projection from CAD-document semantics.
Review Assimp's pinned DXF loader, relevant issue history, release notes, Autodesk's explicit 3DFACE contract, and GDAL's separate raw-ASM DXF route.
Refine PAR-07/S8 comparator selection without adding a local finding, runtime dependency, test, fixture, or support claim.

sources.revision: v6.0.5 release, short source commit 392a658, and its DXFLoader.cpp inspected 2026-10-20; issue pages and later release history inspected the same day. No executable/package was installed or run.
sources.observed: The pinned loader projects a bounded DXF subset into aiScene meshes. It handles POLYLINE, INSERT, 3DFACE/LINE/3DLINE and selected POINT records, and explicitly skips INSERT nested within a BLOCK. There is no DXF 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE modeler-carrier parser in the inspected source. Issue #2645 remains an open feature request for the separate filled DXF SOLID entity; #3286 remains an open report about missing geometry in a multilayer input. Historical 3DFACE INSERT-placement issue #5422 was closed, and fix #5426 is named in v6.0.1 release notes, before v6.0.5.
sources.limits: Issue text is not a reproduction against v6.0.5. A release note does not prove a binary's behavior. Assimp is a scene/mesh projection, not a lossless DXF document model, DXF writer, DWG parser, ACIS/AcDs parser, or general B-rep oracle. Mutable master is not substituted for the pinned release source.

sources.revision: Public documentation inspected 2026-10-20; no GDAL runtime or external drawing used.
sources.observed: Autodesk documents 3DFACE WCS corner values and invisible-edge flags. GDAL's AC1027+ DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASM data and transform rather than converting that carrier into OGR geometry.
sources.limits: The Autodesk entity table is normative only for its documented DXF fields. GDAL raw ASM transport does not establish ACIS/ASM parsing, topology, or semantic validity.

sources.revision: Existing PAR-07/S8 evidence gates and DXF geometry test owners inspected 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: Added Assimp as an optional generated-explicit-geometry scene-projection comparator and specified what it may and may not score. Existing local ASCII/Binary tests remain primary; external CAD/modeler routes remain separate.
sources.limits: No local code/test/fixture/dependency changed. The generated comparator procedure is conditional and not a required platform gate.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: use Assimp only as an optional, pinned DXF-to-scene geometry projection comparator for generated explicit entities; compare expected vertices/faces and transforms, not document identity or round-trip completeness.

PAR-07/S8: separate explicit polygon/face projection from ACIS/ASM carrier extraction, ACIS parser profile, B-rep validity, independently authored topology/analytic expectations, and native consumer acceptance.
PAR-07/S8: record entity omissions, unsupported classes, nested block references, and transforms explicitly; do not treat peer issue text or an old fix note as a current binary result.

planChanges: Added a pinned Assimp v6.0.5 peer-scope row: optional mesh/scene geometry projection only, with explicit omissions and loss of CAD identity/relationships.
Separated planar DXF SOLID from ACIS 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE to avoid a misleading shared name and support claim.
Added a minimized generated-input procedure for 3DFACE, POLYLINE/POLYFACE and bounded INSERT-transform comparisons, with independent analytic expectations and no stored external fixtures.
Kept local fast tests primary, peers optional at composed checkpoints, validation cadence unchanged, and all six external items deferred.
limitations: Assimp's issue reports #2645 and #3286 are unresolved issue-level evidence, not reproduced behavior for v6.0.5.
The release page exposes source commit only as short hash 392a658; no release executable hash was collected because no artifact was run.
No Assimp/GDAL executable, CAD application, ACIS kernel, external drawing, or test corpus was used or downloaded.
No local test or build was run because this was a research-only plan refinement.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
